name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: Edison, Ford, and Otis go with Software, Skyscraper, and Aluminum, in some order.
Software goes with none of Otis, Dam, or Titanium.
Aluminum goes with exactly two of Otis, Electrical, and Rover.
Tungsten goes with at least one of Ford, Civil, or Dam.
